horizon_definition: endpoint after N public actions; each public action contains two control rounds

identical_state_fidelity.check: candidate image rerendered after the reference image; live State checked after every render

limitations: Nominal source mode only; this diagnostic does not cover variation or selected contact fixtures.
Source and candidate trajectories are rendered through the same existing renderer. This does not compare source and candidate renderer implementations.
Exact repeated-state rendering is separate from trajectory-induced pixel drift.
No pixel acceptance cap was applied. Pixel results do not establish numerical physics acceptance.

metric_definitions.changed_channel_fraction: fraction of individual RGB channels that differ
metric_definitions.changed_pixel_fraction: fraction of spatial pixels with any unequal RGB channel
metric_definitions.max_abs_channel_error_uint8: maximum absolute RGB channel error on the 0..255 scale

scope: trajectory-induced drift through the same renderer; no source-renderer fidelity claim or pixel cap
